snippet.title: The Devil Within: Satgat | Tokyo Game Show 2022 Demo Gameplay
snippet.description:

The Devil Within: Satgat Tokyo Game Show Demo Gameplay 

The Devil Within: Satgat is a 2.5D action adventure that follows the journey of a warrior infected with demonic blood. Dig into the secrets of a ruined world while taking down enemies in stylish action sequences.
